mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.student_id, si.id_name AS student_name, si.class_section, si.class_num, si.student_profile_number, sfc.relation_desc FROM sys_student_match m INNER JOIN ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si ON m.student_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = si.student_id INNER JOIN sys_school_family_contact sfc ON sfc.parent_user_id = m.user_id AND sfc.student_user_id = m.student_user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{parentUserId} ORDER BY si.class_section, si.class_num, si.id_name

SELECT m.student_id, si.id_name AS student_name, si.class_section, si.student_profile_number, sfc.relation_desc FROM sys_student_match m INNER JOIN ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si ON m.student_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = si.student_id INNER JOIN sys_school_family_contact sfc ON sfc.parent_user_id = m.user_id AND sfc.student_user_id = m.student_user_id WHERE m.user_id = #{parentUserId} AND m.student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT si.class_section FROM sys_student_match m INNER JOIN ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si ON m.student_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = si.student_id WHERE m.user_id = #{parentUserId} AND m.student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1
